# 본편 웹툰 이미지 — 성인(19세)

본편 컷 이미지 프롬프트. 기본은 트랙 1(글로시 반실사)이고, 콘티 화면 칸이 [트랙2]로 시작하는 컷은 자동으로 트랙 2(코미디 셀) 문구가 붙는다. 각 컷에 장면 연출 메모(장소·조명·의상 HEX), 해당 장소의 SET LOCK, 등장인물의 CHARACTER LOCK이 붙어 있다. 확정 레퍼런스 이미지(handoff/refs/)를 함께 올리고 생성한다. 수위 상한은 콘티와 같다.

## 0-001 (표지 / S#0 표지 (레이크시티 더퍼스트, 9월 1일 화 새벽))
- 샷·앵글·인물: ELS · 부감 · 인물 없음
**이미지 프롬프트**
Korean adult webtoon, semi-realistic glossy digital painting, soft airbrush gradient shading, gentle rim light, fine thin warm-brown lineart, 8-head proportions, cinematic lighting, detailed fabric rendering (silk sheen, velvet depth, knit texture), smooth luminous skin, clean background painting with soft bokeh, vertical webtoon panel composition, no text, no watermark, no logos.
- 캔버스: 800×1800 (세로 스크롤 컷)
- 시대·장소: 2026년 9~10월, 한국 경기도 호수 신도시의 2024년 준공 신축 대단지 '레이크시티 더퍼스트'(가상, 15개 동 3,012세대)와 단지 상가·커뮤니티. 에필로그는 2027년 2월 수원지방법원 형사법정, 2029년 10월 교도소 정문과 새솔신도시 모델하우스(가상). 스마트폰·메신저·스마트워치가 있는 현재.
- 장면 연출 메모(장소·조명·의상): 장소: sets '단지 전체 배치'(15개 동·중앙광장·남동쪽 호수공원·수평선 고속도로) + 다섯 현관(장소 1·5·짧게 A·짧게 B·4) · 조명: 새벽 5시 전 밤 남색 #1A1E3A, 꺼진 창 사이 몇 개만 금빛 보케 #F2C26B, 호수 위 가로등 반사가 길게 흔들림 · 의상: 인물 없음(0-002·0-003은 문·신발·소품·화면만, 얼굴 없음) · 트랙: 1 · 감정 목표: 3,012세대 불빛 속에 다섯 개의 문이 숨어 있고, 그 문을 다 여는 남자는 하나라는 것을 얼굴 없이 먼저 보여 준다.
- 장소 고정값:
- 장소 1 101동 3801호 펜트하우스 — 유진의 집 — SET LOCK: Penthouse unit 3801 on the 38th, top floor of a new 2024-built Korean high-rise apartment tower in a Gyeonggi new town. Polished white marble floor throughout, warm white walls, minimal luxury interior. The living room's south wall is one floor-to-ceiling glass wall about 9 m wide, five panes with slim black mullions and a low marble sill, overlooking a wide calm lake far below with a lit lakeside promenade and a distant highway on the horizon. Grey fabric sofa, white ceramic kitchen island with two round pendant lamps. Master bedroom in the southeast corner with frameless corner glass on two sides, a king bed against the inner wall facing the glass.
- 화면·연출: 남동쪽 호수 위 하늘에서 내려다본 레이크시티 더퍼스트 야경. 중앙광장과 물결놀이터를 고리처럼 둘러싼 열다섯 개 동, 창은 대부분 꺼져 있고, 그중 다섯 개(101동 38층, 503동 24층, 304동 12층, 207동 8층, 412동 5층)에만 아주 옅게 회색·금색·버건디·민트·하늘색 기운이 돈다. 아래쪽에 호수와 산책로 가로등 점선, 수평선에 고속도로 불빛 띠가 길게 흐르고, 동쪽 하늘 끝만 푸른 기가 오른다. 화면 위 1/3 하늘 여백에 제목 식자 자리, 맨 아래 호수 위 여백에 고지문 식자 자리(작게, Gowun Batang).
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- (인물 없음 또는 실루엣)
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).
- 말풍선·글자는 이미지에 넣지 말 것 (레터링은 후공정)

**레터링(후공정)**
  - [caption] 제목: 단톡방에 그 남자가 있다
  - [caption] 고지문: 실화를 모티프로 했으며, 인물·지명·회사는 모두 지어낸 것이다.

**금지·수위**
- 모든 얼굴은 창작된 성인 — 실존 인물·유명인과 닮게 만들지 않는다(실화 모티프 작품)
- 실제 브랜드 로고·엠블럼, 실제 화폐 도안, 법원·경찰·교도소 휘장 금지(로고 없는 시계, 퀼팅 체인 백, 도안 없는 소품용 지폐)
- 이미지 안에 말풍선·글자·간판 문구를 넣지 않는다(레터링은 후공정)
- 미성년으로 보이는 표현 금지 — 하린(25)은 성인 체형·성숙한 표정
- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다
- 참고 썸네일: thumbs/0-001.svg

## 1-001 (1화. 너한테만 하는 얘긴데 / S#1 관리란 결국 (지하 2층 주차장 B구역, 9월 1일 화 새벽 5:10))
- 샷·앵글·인물: LS · 하이 · 도겸(중·후경)
**이미지 프롬프트**
Korean adult webtoon, semi-realistic glossy digital painting, soft airbrush gradient shading, gentle rim light, fine thin warm-brown lineart, 8-head proportions, cinematic lighting, detailed fabric rendering (silk sheen, velvet depth, knit texture), smooth luminous skin, clean background painting with soft bokeh, vertical webtoon panel composition, no text, no watermark, no logos.
- 캔버스: 800×1400 (세로 스크롤 컷)
- 시대·장소: 2026년 9~10월, 한국 경기도 호수 신도시의 2024년 준공 신축 대단지 '레이크시티 더퍼스트'(가상, 15개 동 3,012세대)와 단지 상가·커뮤니티. 에필로그는 2027년 2월 수원지방법원 형사법정, 2029년 10월 교도소 정문과 새솔신도시 모델하우스(가상). 스마트폰·메신저·스마트워치가 있는 현재.
- 장면 연출 메모(장소·조명·의상): 장소 8(지하 2층 주차장 B구역, 카메라 C1 트렁크 안쪽) · 조명: 천장 직관등이 한 줄 건너 하나씩만 켜져 4500K(약간 녹색 기)로 위에서 띄엄띄엄, 열린 트렁크 실내등 3000K, 젖은 듯 번들거리는 바닥에 길게 번진 반사(9/19 도색 전이라 타이어 자국이 남은 바랜 녹색 에폭시) · 의상: 도겸 형광 연두 대리운전 조끼 #C8E62E(벗어서 만다) 아래 흰 셔츠 #F4F4F2(소매 팔뚝까지 걷음, 단추 끝까지 채웠다가 두 개 풂)·차콜 슬랙스 #2B2F3A·갈색 가죽 로퍼·왼손 금장 콤비 시계와 초승달 흉터 · 트랙: 1 · 감정 목표: 밤일의 피로를 조끼와 함께 말아 넣고, 색 하나로 다른 남자가 되는 '관리'의 첫 동작을 차갑게 보여 준다.
- 장소 고정값:
- 장소 8 지하 2층 주차장 B구역·동 연결통로·엘리베이터 홀 — SET LOCK: Underground parking level B2, zone B, of a new 2024-built Korean mega apartment complex. A low concrete ceiling with exposed ducts and jet fans, two long rows of linear tube lights, square concrete columns wrapped with orange zone bands at waist height, a glossy green epoxy floor with white parking lines, slightly wet and reflective. An exit ramp curving upward at the far end. Behind, a glass automatic door into a bright elevator lobby and the mouth of a long white underground corridor that links the fifteen apartment buildings. Cool, humming, damp and empty.
- 화면·연출: B구역 통로를 위에서 비스듬히 내려다본다. 직관등이 한 줄 건너 하나씩 꺼져 주황 띠를 두른 기둥 줄이 띄엄띄엄 밝고, 동쪽 벽 칸에 로고 없는 검정 대형 세단이 트렁크를 통로 쪽으로 열어 두었다. 그 앞에 형광 연두 조끼를 입은 도겸의 작은 형체, 젖은 바닥에 직관등 빛이 길게 번지고 천장 제트팬이 어둡게 돈다. 효과음은 붓 효과음(East Sea Dokdo)으로 제트팬 옆, 내레이션 박스 좌상, 시각 자막 '9월 1일(화) 새벽 5:10' 우상 식자.
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).
- 말풍선·글자는 이미지에 넣지 말 것 (레터링은 후공정)

- (SET LOCK 없음: 연출 메모의 콘티 지정 배경을 따른다)

- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).
- 말풍선·글자는 이미지에 넣지 말 것 (레터링은 후공정)

**레터링(후공정)**
  - [narration] 내레이션: 일곱 시 반, 노란 셔틀버스가 단지 정문 앞에 섰다.

**금지·수위**

- 이미지 안에 말풍선·글자·간판 문구를 넣지 않는다(레터링은 후공정)
- 미성년으로 보이는 표현 금지 — 하린(25)은 성인 체형·성숙한 표정
- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다

Two scrub tables covered with clear plastic sheets, plastic basins and dippers stacked on a wall shelf, a bar of mugwort soap, folded white towels. Right beside the scrub corner, a hot bath with a tiled rim to sit on and water circulating from a spout; a row of low seated shower stations along the far wall, a frosted glass half partition.

- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.

Cool, humming, damp and empty.
- 장소 7 더퍼스트 클럽 사우나 — 여탕 세신실·열탕 — SET LOCK: The scrub corner of a women's bathhouse in the basement sauna of a new Korean apartment complex community center. Wet pale aqua-white tiles on walls and floor, thick white steam hanging everywhere, round ceiling lights glowing like blurred moons through the steam, no windows. Two scrub tables covered with clear plastic sheets, plastic basins and dippers stacked on a wall shelf, a bar of mugwort soap, folded white towels. Right beside the scrub corner, a hot bath with a tiled rim to sit on and water circulating from a spout; a row of low seated shower stations along the far wall, a frosted glass half partition.

- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 순옥: Park Sun-ok, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 61-year-old Korean woman, a bathhouse body-scrub attendant for forty years, 155 cm, a compact 6.5-head build, shorter and sturdier than the rest of the cast. Solid working body: broad shoulders, thick forearms, thick calves, a slightly stooped back, plain unglamorous figure. Round face with cheeks flushed by steam and sun; THICK STRAIGHT dark eyebrows, the same family brows as her son; small droopy eyes; a wide nose; thin lips always pressed shut. Weathered warm skin (#E3B48E) with a reddish steam flush, lined by age and labor. Short graying permed bob (#8E8A86), under a mesh hair cap at work. Signature: thick, firm, warm hands with big knuckles, scrub-mitt calluses on the palms, very short water-softened nails, a pain-relief patch on the right wrist. Habits: silent, eyes lowered to towels, backs and hands; folds a towel in half and in half again with all four corners matching. Never sensual, always dignified.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).

Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. The living room's south wall is one floor-to-ceiling glass wall about 9 m wide, five panes with slim black mullions and a low marble sill, overlooking a wide calm lake far below with a lit lakeside promenade and a distant highway on the horizon. Grey fabric sofa, white ceramic kitchen island with two round pendant lamps. Master bedroom in the southeast corner with frameless corner glass on two sides, a king bed against the inner wall facing the glass.

Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 유진: Seo Yu-jin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 33-year-old Korean woman, former flight attendant, 172 cm, the tallest woman of the cast. Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.

Polished white marble floor throughout, warm white walls, minimal luxury interior. The living room's south wall is one floor-to-ceiling glass wall about 9 m wide, five panes with slim black mullions and a low marble sill, overlooking a wide calm lake far below with a lit lakeside promenade and a distant highway on the horizon. Grey fabric sofa, white ceramic kitchen island with two round pendant lamps. Master bedroom in the southeast corner with frameless corner glass on two sides, a king bed against the inner wall facing the glass.

Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 유진: Seo Yu-jin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 33-year-old Korean woman, former flight attendant, 172 cm, the tallest woman of the cast. Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.

Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.

Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.

Warm mature hourglass with weight: full heavy bust, softly cinched waist, wide round hips, smooth calves in sheer stockings, a long graceful neck; a slow, low-centered, unhurried body. Soft rounded face with a still-firm jawline and fine smile lines at the eyes; long narrow eyes with elegant winged eyeliner; high thin painted arched brows; straight nose; plump wine-red lips. A 42-year-old Korean woman, elegant wealthy housewife and residents' association president, 166 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Warm mature hourglass with weight: full heavy bust, softly cinched waist, wide round hips, smooth calves in sheer stockings, a long graceful neck; a slow, low-centered, unhurried body. Soft rounded face with a still-firm jawline and fine smile lines at the eyes; long narrow eyes with elegant winged eyeliner; high thin painted arched brows; straight nose; plump wine-red lips. Well-kept skin (#F0CDB4). Dark chocolate hair (#2B1D16) in a loose low chignon at the nape with a few strands falling. A white leather sofa against the right wall faces a beige marble feature wall with a TV and a round wall clock, a rectangular glass coffee table between them. The entry hall has a dark walnut console with a white lily arrangement and a framed photo. Master bedroom: a queen bed on thin metal legs, headboard against the wall, facing the window.

Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.

A 42-year-old Korean woman, elegant wealthy housewife and residents' association president, 166 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Warm mature hourglass with weight: full heavy bust, softly cinched waist, wide round hips, smooth calves in sheer stockings, a long graceful neck; a slow, low-centered, unhurried body. Soft rounded face with a still-firm jawline and fine smile lines at the eyes; long narrow eyes with elegant winged eyeliner; high thin painted arched brows; straight nose; plump wine-red lips. Well-kept skin (#F0CDB4). Dark chocolate hair (#2B1D16) in a loose low chignon at the nape with a few strands falling. Signature: a single strand of 44 pearls restrung on a visibly new bright-white silk thread, pearl stud earrings, glossy red nails, a faint pale mark on the bare left ring finger. - 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다
- 허용: 몸 라인이 드러나는 의상, 속옷·슬립, 옷이 벗겨지는 과정, 드러난 등·어깨·쇄골·허리·허벅지, 시트로 가린 나신, 역광 실루엣, 손과 입술, 땀과 숨

A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.

A white leather sofa against the right wall faces a beige marble feature wall with a TV and a round wall clock, a rectangular glass coffee table between them. The entry hall has a dark walnut console with a white lily arrangement and a framed photo. Master bedroom: a queen bed on thin metal legs, headboard against the wall, facing the window.

A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger.   - [narration] 내레이션: 세 사람 모두 그를 몰랐다. 3,012세대는 그런 숫자였다.

Polished white marble floor, cream walls, a south-facing living room window about 5 m wide with charcoal blackout curtains over sheer white curtains. A white leather sofa against the right wall faces a beige marble feature wall with a TV and a round wall clock, a rectangular glass coffee table between them. The entry hall has a dark walnut console with a white lily arrangement and a framed photo. Master bedroom: a queen bed on thin metal legs, headboard against the wall, facing the window.
- 화면·연출: 도겸의 등 뒤로 2402호 현관문이 열리고 혜숙이 들어선다. 네이비 저지 원피스가 가슴의 굴곡과 잘록한 허리, 둥근 골반을 끊김 없이 감싸 흐르고, 다시 틀어 올린 시뇽에 몇 가닥이 흘러내린다. 쇄골 아래 진주가 있던 자리를 홀 조명이 하얗게 비워 둔다. 효과음은 문틀 옆 붓 효과음(East Sea Dokdo), 말풍선은 혜숙 머리 위 우상.

Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. - 혜숙: Jeong Hye-suk, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 42-year-old Korean woman, elegant wealthy housewife and residents' association president, 166 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Warm mature hourglass with weight: full heavy bust, softly cinched waist, wide round hips, smooth calves in sheer stockings, a long graceful neck; a slow, low-centered, unhurried body. Soft rounded face with a still-firm jawline and fine smile lines at the eyes; long narrow eyes with elegant winged eyeliner; high thin painted arched brows; straight nose; plump wine-red lips. Well-kept skin (#F0CDB4). Dark chocolate hair (#2B1D16) in a loose low chignon at the nape with a few strands falling. Signature: a single strand of 44 pearls restrung on a visibly new bright-white silk thread, pearl stud earrings, glossy red nails, a faint pale mark on the bare left ring finger. Habits: covers her mouth with her hand when she smiles, fingers drift up to the pearls, looks down with her chin raised, perches on the edges of beds and tables.

A dark walnut bar counter 6 m long runs along the right wall with six bar stools, an overhead rack of upside-down wine glasses, and five red glass pendant lamps in a row above it. Behind the counter, a back-bar shelf with a blank chalkboard menu. Along the left wall: a small round marble corner table near the front, a burgundy velvet Chesterfield sofa, and two tall glass-door wine cellars at the back. Dark burgundy hexagon floor tiles, wooden louver blinds on the front glass.

- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.

A dark walnut bar counter 6 m long runs along the right wall with six bar stools, an overhead rack of upside-down wine glasses, and five red glass pendant lamps in a row above it. Behind the counter, a back-bar shelf with a blank chalkboard menu. Along the left wall: a small round marble corner table near the front, a burgundy velvet Chesterfield sofa, and two tall glass-door wine cellars at the back. Dark burgundy hexagon floor tiles, wooden louver blinds on the front glass.
- 화면·연출: 가로 2분할. 좌: 미란이 휴대폰을 들어 카메라를 켠다. 우: 도겸이 손바닥으로 렌즈를 가볍게 막으며 웃는다(손바닥 너머 눈만). 말풍선 좌상, 우상.

- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.

Korean adult webtoon, semi-realistic glossy digital painting, soft airbrush gradient shading, gentle rim light, fine thin warm-brown lineart, 8-head proportions, cinematic lighting, detailed fabric rendering (silk sheen, velvet depth, knit texture), smooth luminous skin, clean background painting with soft bokeh, vertical webtoon panel composition, no text, no watermark, no logos.
- 캔버스: 800×1200 (세로 스크롤 컷)
- 시대·장소: 2026년 9~10월, 한국 경기도 호수 신도시의 2024년 준공 신축 대단지 '레이크시티 더퍼스트'(가상, 15개 동 3,012세대)와 단지 상가·커뮤니티. 에필로그는 2027년 2월 수원지방법원 형사법정, 2029년 10월 교도소 정문과 새솔신도시 모델하우스(가상). 스마트폰·메신저·스마트워치가 있는 현재.

- 장소 고정값:
- 장소 2 와인바 '미란' — 퍼스트 애비뉴 1층 — SET LOCK: Small Korean wine bar called Miran on the ground floor of a new apartment complex shopping street, about 7 m wide and 12 m deep. A dark walnut bar counter 6 m long runs along the right wall with six bar stools, an overhead rack of upside-down wine glasses, and five red glass pendant lamps in a row above it. Behind the counter, a back-bar shelf with a blank chalkboard menu. Along the left wall: a small round marble corner table near the front, a burgundy velvet Chesterfield sofa, and two tall glass-door wine cellars at the back. Dark burgundy hexagon floor tiles, wooden louver blinds on the front glass.
- 화면·연출: 미란이 카운터를 짚고 가볍게 몸을 띄워 걸터앉고, 도겸이 그녀의 무릎 사이로 들어선다. 슬릿이 저절로 갈라지며 허벅지가 붉은 빛 아래 통째로 드러나고, 하이힐 뒤꿈치가 그의 허벅지 뒤에 걸려 그를 당긴다. 위쪽 전경에 랙의 잔들이 흐리게 걸린다.

- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.

- 장소 2 와인바 '미란' — 퍼스트 애비뉴 1층 — SET LOCK: Small Korean wine bar called Miran on the ground floor of a new apartment complex shopping street, about 7 m wide and 12 m deep. A dark walnut bar counter 6 m long runs along the right wall with six bar stools, an overhead rack of upside-down wine glasses, and five red glass pendant lamps in a row above it. Behind the counter, a back-bar shelf with a blank chalkboard menu. Along the left wall: a small round marble corner table near the front, a burgundy velvet Chesterfield sofa, and two tall glass-door wine cellars at the back. Dark burgundy hexagon floor tiles, wooden louver blinds on the front glass.
- 화면·연출: 휴대폰 화면 빛이 미란의 얼굴을 아래에서 하얗게 비춘다. 사진이 '숨김 앨범' 폴더로 들어가는 화면이 전경에 흐리게 걸리고, 붉은 립의 입꼬리가 아주 조금 올라간다. 내레이션 박스 하단.
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).

**이미지 프롬프트**
Korean adult webtoon, semi-realistic glossy digital painting, soft airbrush gradient shading, gentle rim light, fine thin warm-brown lineart, 8-head proportions, cinematic lighting, detailed fabric rendering (silk sheen, velvet depth, knit texture), smooth luminous skin, clean background painting with soft bokeh, vertical webtoon panel composition, no text, no watermark, no logos.
- 캔버스: 800×640 (세로 스크롤 컷)
- 시대·장소: 2026년 9~10월, 한국 경기도 호수 신도시의 2024년 준공 신축 대단지 '레이크시티 더퍼스트'(가상, 15개 동 3,012세대)와 단지 상가·커뮤니티. 에필로그는 2027년 2월 수원지방법원 형사법정, 2029년 10월 교도소 정문과 새솔신도시 모델하우스(가상). 스마트폰·메신저·스마트워치가 있는 현재.
- 장면 연출 메모(장소·조명·의상): 장소 3(더퍼스트 클럽 B1 필라테스룸, 카메라 C1·C3) · 조명: 천장 꺼짐, 거울 벽 아래 간접 LED 4000K만 바닥에서 낮게 거울에 두 배로 반사, 데스크 모니터의 푸른빛, 문 위 비상구 유도등 초록 · 의상: 세라 검정 레깅스 #1B1C1F·차콜 크롭 브라톱 #2A2C30·블랙 하이 포니테일 #1C1F26(잔머리)·왼손목 스마트워치 · 트랙: 1 · 감정 목표: 숫자를 세는 여자가 숫자 하나를 보고도 덮는다. 불편함의 씨앗.
- 장소 고정값:
- 장소 3 더퍼스트 클럽 지하 1층 — 필라테스룸·안내데스크 — SET LOCK: Basement pilates studio in the community center of a new Korean apartment complex, about 8 by 8.5 meters, no windows. The left wall is a full mirror wall of six tall panels with a thin LED light strip along the floor beneath it. Six oak-frame pilates reformers with charcoal carriages and red springs stand in one row, foot bars toward the mirror. Light oak flooring with black rubber mats, recessed ceiling downlights, two ventilation grilles high on the back wall. A glass door and glass partition on the near wall, a small instructor desk with a monitor and a coat stand in the corner by the door.
- 화면·연출: 가로 2분할. 좌: 데스크 모니터 출입 기록 창 맨 아랫줄 '22:04 B2 연결통로 출입'(글자는 식자, 푸른빛). 우: 세라의 휴대폰 문자 화면, 22:04 '도착' 한 단어(손글씨체는 쓰지 않고 메신저 서체).
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 세라: Oh Se-ra, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 28-year-old Korean woman, pilates instructor and former rhythmic gymnast, 168 cm. Toned athletic-curvy body: high, firm, rounded bust, defined abs, small waist, visible hip-bone lines, round firm glutes, strong outer thighs, straight legs, square shoulders with sharp shoulder blades. Two distinct Venus dimples on the lower back just above the waistband, her signature, visible in every back view. Heart-shaped face, bright round eyes, thick short straight brows, small slightly upturned nose with light freckles across the bridge, even full lips with only lip balm. Warm tan bronze skin (#D9A982). Black (#1C1F26) straight hair to mid-back tied in a high bouncy ponytail with loose baby hairs at the temples. Smartwatch on the left wrist, a hair tie, short clear nails, a small surgical scar on the inner left ankle. Habits: spine always upright, walks silently with the ponytail swinging, short laugh through the nose, stretches when annoyed.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).
- 말풍선·글자는 이미지에 넣지 말 것 (레터링은 후공정)

**레터링(후공정)**
  - [dialogue] 문자(도겸→세라): 도착

**금지·수위**
- 모든 얼굴은 창작된 성인 — 실존 인물·유명인과 닮게 만들지 않는다(실화 모티프 작품)
- 실제 브랜드 로고·엠블럼, 실제 화폐 도안, 법원·경찰·교도소 휘장 금지(로고 없는 시계, 퀼팅 체인 백, 도안 없는 소품용 지폐)

- 미성년으로 보이는 표현 금지 — 하린(25)은 성인 체형·성숙한 표정
- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다
- 허용: 몸 라인이 드러나는 의상, 속옷·슬립, 옷이 벗겨지는 과정, 드러난 등·어깨·쇄골·허리·허벅지, 시트로 가린 나신, 역광 실루엣, 손과 입술, 땀과 숨
- 금지: 성기, 유두 노출, 삽입·성행위의 직접 묘사, 체액

A glass door and glass partition on the near wall, a small instructor desk with a monitor and a coat stand in the corner by the door.
- 화면·연출: 그가 브라톱 밑단을 잡아 끌어올리고, 땀에 젖은 밴드가 피부에 달라붙자 세라가 두 팔을 들어 돕는다. 포니테일이 천을 빠져나오며 등을 철썩 친다. 벗겨지는 천과 들어 올린 팔뚝이 가슴 앞선을 가리고, 바닥 간접광은 측면에서만 들어와 등·어깨·쇄골·복근 옆선에만 림라이트를 긋고 앞면은 그늘로 남긴다. 효과음은 등 쪽 붓 효과음(East Sea Dokdo).

Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.

Toned athletic-curvy body: high, firm, rounded bust, defined abs, small waist, visible hip-bone lines, round firm glutes, strong outer thighs, straight legs, square shoulders with sharp shoulder blades. Two distinct Venus dimples on the lower back just above the waistband, her signature, visible in every back view. Heart-shaped face, bright round eyes, thick short straight brows, small slightly upturned nose with light freckles across the bridge, even full lips with only lip balm. Warm tan bronze skin (#D9A982). Black (#1C1F26) straight hair to mid-back tied in a high bouncy ponytail with loose baby hairs at the temples. Smartwatch on the left wrist, a hair tie, short clear nails, a small surgical scar on the inner left ankle. Habits: spine always upright, walks silently with the ponytail swinging, short laugh through the nose, stretches when annoyed.

- 장소 7 더퍼스트 클럽 사우나 — 여탕 세신실·열탕 — SET LOCK: The scrub corner of a women's bathhouse in the basement sauna of a new Korean apartment complex community center. Wet pale aqua-white tiles on walls and floor, thick white steam hanging everywhere, round ceiling lights glowing like blurred moons through the steam, no windows. Two scrub tables covered with clear plastic sheets, plastic basins and dippers stacked on a wall shelf, a bar of mugwort soap, folded white towels. Right beside the scrub corner, a hot bath with a tiled rim to sit on and water circulating from a spout; a row of low seated shower stations along the far wall, a frosted glass half partition.
- 화면·연출: 김 속. 수건을 두르고 나가는 세라와, 유리 미닫이를 열고 들어오는 미란이 마주친다. 두 사람 다 수건 위로 어깨와 쇄골만 보인다. 시각 캡션은 좌상 박스, 세라 말풍선 좌.

- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.
- 세라: Oh Se-ra, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 28-year-old Korean woman, pilates instructor and former rhythmic gymnast, 168 cm. Toned athletic-curvy body: high, firm, rounded bust, defined abs, small waist, visible hip-bone lines, round firm glutes, strong outer thighs, straight legs, square shoulders with sharp shoulder blades. Two distinct Venus dimples on the lower back just above the waistband, her signature, visible in every back view. Heart-shaped face, bright round eyes, thick short straight brows, small slightly upturned nose with light freckles across the bridge, even full lips with only lip balm. Warm tan bronze skin (#D9A982). Black (#1C1F26) straight hair to mid-back tied in a high bouncy ponytail with loose baby hairs at the temples. Smartwatch on the left wrist, a hair tie, short clear nails, a small surgical scar on the inner left ankle. Habits: spine always upright, walks silently with the ponytail swinging, short laugh through the nose, stretches when annoyed.

  - [dialogue] 세라: 어, 사장님.

**금지·수위**
- 모든 얼굴은 창작된 성인 — 실존 인물·유명인과 닮게 만들지 않는다(실화 모티프 작품)
- 실제 브랜드 로고·엠블럼, 실제 화폐 도안, 법원·경찰·교도소 휘장 금지(로고 없는 시계, 퀼팅 체인 백, 도안 없는 소품용 지폐)
- 이미지 안에 말풍선·글자·간판 문구를 넣지 않는다(레터링은 후공정)
- 미성년으로 보이는 표현 금지 — 하린(25)은 성인 체형·성숙한 표정
- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다
- 허용: 몸 라인이 드러나는 의상, 속옷·슬립, 옷이 벗겨지는 과정, 드러난 등·어깨·쇄골·허리·허벅지, 시트로 가린 나신, 역광 실루엣, 손과 입술, 땀과 숨
- 금지: 성기, 유두 노출, 삽입·성행위의 직접 묘사, 체액
- 생성기가 거절하면 가림 소품(시트·커튼·와인잔·셔츠 자락) → 실루엣 → 손·입술·사물 인서트 순서로 바꾼다

Warm tan bronze skin (#D9A982). Black (#1C1F26) straight hair to mid-back tied in a high bouncy ponytail with loose baby hairs at the temples. Smartwatch on the left wrist, a hair tie, short clear nails, a small surgical scar on the inner left ankle. Habits: spine always upright, walks silently with the ponytail swinging, short laugh through the nose, stretches when annoyed.

A 61-year-old Korean woman, a bathhouse body-scrub attendant for forty years, 155 cm, a compact 6.5-head build, shorter and sturdier than the rest of the cast. Solid working body: broad shoulders, thick forearms, thick calves, a slightly stooped back, plain unglamorous figure. Round face with cheeks flushed by steam and sun; THICK STRAIGHT dark eyebrows, the same family brows as her son; small droopy eyes; a wide nose; thin lips always pressed shut. Weathered warm skin (#E3B48E) with a reddish steam flush, lined by age and labor. Short graying permed bob (#8E8A86), under a mesh hair cap at work. - 장소 7 더퍼스트 클럽 사우나 — 여탕 세신실·열탕 — SET LOCK: The scrub corner of a women's bathhouse in the basement sauna of a new Korean apartment complex community center. Wet pale aqua-white tiles on walls and floor, thick white steam hanging everywhere, round ceiling lights glowing like blurred moons through the steam, no windows. Two scrub tables covered with clear plastic sheets, plastic basins and dippers stacked on a wall shelf, a bar of mugwort soap, folded white towels. Right beside the scrub corner, a hot bath with a tiled rim to sit on and water circulating from a spout; a row of low seated shower stations along the far wall, a frosted glass half partition.
- 화면·연출: 미란의 견갑골 위에서 순옥의 손이 아주 조금 느려진다(같은 칸 안에서 손의 잔상 간격이 좁아진다). 미란의 말풍선은 화면 밖.

- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.
- 순옥: Park Sun-ok, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 61-year-old Korean woman, a bathhouse body-scrub attendant for forty years, 155 cm, a compact 6.5-head build, shorter and sturdier than the rest of the cast. Solid working body: broad shoulders, thick forearms, thick calves, a slightly stooped back, plain unglamorous figure. Round face with cheeks flushed by steam and sun; THICK STRAIGHT dark eyebrows, the same family brows as her son; small droopy eyes; a wide nose; thin lips always pressed shut. Weathered warm skin (#E3B48E) with a reddish steam flush, lined by age and labor. Short graying permed bob (#8E8A86), under a mesh hair cap at work. Signature: thick, firm, warm hands with big knuckles, scrub-mitt calluses on the palms, very short water-softened nails, a pain-relief patch on the right wrist. Habits: silent, eyes lowered to towels, backs and hands; folds a towel in half and in half again with all four corners matching. Never sensual, always dignified.

**금지·수위**
- 모든 얼굴은 창작된 성인 — 실존 인물·유명인과 닮게 만들지 않는다(실화 모티프 작품)
- 실제 브랜드 로고·엠블럼, 실제 화폐 도안, 법원·경찰·교도소 휘장 금지(로고 없는 시계, 퀼팅 체인 백, 도안 없는 소품용 지폐)
- 이미지 안에 말풍선·글자·간판 문구를 넣지 않는다(레터링은 후공정)
- 미성년으로 보이는 표현 금지 — 하린(25)은 성인 체형·성숙한 표정
- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다
- 허용: 몸 라인이 드러나는 의상, 속옷·슬립, 옷이 벗겨지는 과정, 드러난 등·어깨·쇄골·허리·허벅지, 시트로 가린 나신, 역광 실루엣, 손과 입술, 땀과 숨

- 생성기가 거절하면 가림 소품(시트·커튼·와인잔·셔츠 자락) → 실루엣 → 손·입술·사물 인서트 순서로 바꾼다

Wet pale aqua-white tiles on walls and floor, thick white steam hanging everywhere, round ceiling lights glowing like blurred moons through the steam, no windows. Two scrub tables covered with clear plastic sheets, plastic basins and dippers stacked on a wall shelf, a bar of mugwort soap, folded white towels. Right beside the scrub corner, a hot bath with a tiled rim to sit on and water circulating from a spout; a row of low seated shower stations along the far wall, a frosted glass half partition.
- 화면·연출: 미란이 세신대 옆 선반으로 팔을 뻗어 방수팩에 든 휴대폰을 집고, 엄지로 몇 번 넘긴 뒤 화면을 순옥 쪽으로 돌린다. 미란은 엎드린 채 팔만 들어 올린다(수건 그대로). 말풍선 두 개 좌상.

The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.
- 순옥: Park Sun-ok, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 61-year-old Korean woman, a bathhouse body-scrub attendant for forty years, 155 cm, a compact 6.5-head build, shorter and sturdier than the rest of the cast. Solid working body: broad shoulders, thick forearms, thick calves, a slightly stooped back, plain unglamorous figure. Round face with cheeks flushed by steam and sun; THICK STRAIGHT dark eyebrows, the same family brows as her son; small droopy eyes; a wide nose; thin lips always pressed shut. Weathered warm skin (#E3B48E) with a reddish steam flush, lined by age and labor. Short graying permed bob (#8E8A86), under a mesh hair cap at work. Signature: thick, firm, warm hands with big knuckles, scrub-mitt calluses on the palms, very short water-softened nails, a pain-relief patch on the right wrist. Habits: silent, eyes lowered to towels, backs and hands; folds a towel in half and in half again with all four corners matching. Never sensual, always dignified.

  - [dialogue] 미란: 손 예쁘지, 이모? 자기도 봐 봐.

- 이미지 안에 말풍선·글자·간판 문구를 넣지 않는다(레터링은 후공정)

- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다
- 허용: 몸 라인이 드러나는 의상, 속옷·슬립, 옷이 벗겨지는 과정, 드러난 등·어깨·쇄골·허리·허벅지, 시트로 가린 나신, 역광 실루엣, 손과 입술, 땀과 숨
- 금지: 성기, 유두 노출, 삽입·성행위의 직접 묘사, 체액
- 생성기가 거절하면 가림 소품(시트·커튼·와인잔·셔츠 자락) → 실루엣 → 손·입술·사물 인서트 순서로 바꾼다

Solid working body: broad shoulders, thick forearms, thick calves, a slightly stooped back, plain unglamorous figure. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. - 순옥: Park Sun-ok, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 61-year-old Korean woman, a bathhouse body-scrub attendant for forty years, 155 cm, a compact 6.5-head build, shorter and sturdier than the rest of the cast. Solid working body: broad shoulders, thick forearms, thick calves, a slightly stooped back, plain unglamorous figure. Round face with cheeks flushed by steam and sun; THICK STRAIGHT dark eyebrows, the same family brows as her son; small droopy eyes; a wide nose; thin lips always pressed shut. Weathered warm skin (#E3B48E) with a reddish steam flush, lined by age and labor. Short graying permed bob (#8E8A86), under a mesh hair cap at work. Signature: thick, firm, warm hands with big knuckles, scrub-mitt calluses on the palms, very short water-softened nails, a pain-relief patch on the right wrist. Habits: silent, eyes lowered to towels, backs and hands; folds a towel in half and in half again with all four corners matching. Never sensual, always dignified.

- 장소 고정값:
- 장소 7 더퍼스트 클럽 사우나 — 여탕 세신실·열탕 — SET LOCK: The scrub corner of a women's bathhouse in the basement sauna of a new Korean apartment complex community center. Wet pale aqua-white tiles on walls and floor, thick white steam hanging everywhere, round ceiling lights glowing like blurred moons through the steam, no windows. Two scrub tables covered with clear plastic sheets, plastic basins and dippers stacked on a wall shelf, a bar of mugwort soap, folded white towels. Right beside the scrub corner, a hot bath with a tiled rim to sit on and water circulating from a spout; a row of low seated shower stations along the far wall, a frosted glass half partition.
- 화면·연출: 회차 끝 훅. 김이 걷힌 투명한 공기 속 순옥의 얼굴이 정면으로 움직이지 않는다. 짙은 일자 눈썹, 다문 입술, 젖은 볼, 눈은 아무 데도 보지 않는다. 화면 아래로 이태리타월을 감은 손이 등 위에 멈춘 채 걸리고, 효과음 없이 위아래 긴 여백, 내레이션 박스는 얼굴 아래 한가운데.
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 순옥: Park Sun-ok, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 61-year-old Korean woman, a bathhouse body-scrub attendant for forty years, 155 cm, a compact 6.5-head build, shorter and sturdier than the rest of the cast. Solid working body: broad shoulders, thick forearms, thick calves, a slightly stooped back, plain unglamorous figure. Round face with cheeks flushed by steam and sun; THICK STRAIGHT dark eyebrows, the same family brows as her son; small droopy eyes; a wide nose; thin lips always pressed shut. Weathered warm skin (#E3B48E) with a reddish steam flush, lined by age and labor. Short graying permed bob (#8E8A86), under a mesh hair cap at work. Signature: thick, firm, warm hands with big knuckles, scrub-mitt calluses on the palms, very short water-softened nails, a pain-relief patch on the right wrist. Habits: silent, eyes lowered to towels, backs and hands; folds a towel in half and in half again with all four corners matching. Never sensual, always dignified.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).

  - [narration] 내레이션: 순옥은 그 손을 알았다. 서른두 해 전, 처음으로 씻긴 손이었다.

Ahead, a sliding double window with a half-raised white roller blind, looking down on a lakeside park lawn with a few streetlights. On the right wall, a narrow single bed with plain light bedding. Ivory wallpaper, light wood-look vinyl floor, tidy but cramped student life.
- 화면·연출: 가로 2분할. 좌: 하린은 판례에서 눈을 떼지 않은 채 형광펜 끝으로 같은 줄을 짚으며 대답한다, 말풍선 좌상. 우: 의자 뒤에 선 도겸이 두 손을 하린의 맨어깨에 얹고 정수리 너머로 법전을 내려다본다, 왼쪽 입꼬리만 조금 올라간 얼굴, 말풍선 우상.

Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. On the left wall, a bookshelf crammed with thick law code books and a simple desk beside the window with one desk lamp, a laptop, highlighter pens in a cup and a swivel chair. Ahead, a sliding double window with a half-raised white roller blind, looking down on a lakeside park lawn with a few streetlights. On the right wall, a narrow single bed with plain light bedding. Ivory wallpaper, light wood-look vinyl floor, tidy but cramped student life.

A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 하린: Yoon Ha-rin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. Habits: pushes up glasses that are already up; slightly hunched student posture that straightens when her hair is tied; bursts out laughing.

  - [dialogue] 하린: 방해… 하셔도 돼요.

- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다
- 허용: 몸 라인이 드러나는 의상, 속옷·슬립, 옷이 벗겨지는 과정, 드러난 등·어깨·쇄골·허리·허벅지, 시트로 가린 나신, 역광 실루엣, 손과 입술, 땀과 숨
- 금지: 성기, 유두 노출, 삽입·성행위의 직접 묘사, 체액
- 생성기가 거절하면 가림 소품(시트·커튼·와인잔·셔츠 자락) → 실루엣 → 손·입술·사물 인서트 순서로 바꾼다

Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. - 장소 4 412동 502호 — 하린의 전세방 — SET LOCK: A small rented room in unit 502 on the 5th floor of a new 2024-built Korean apartment building, a law student's room about 3 by 3.6 meters. On the left wall, a bookshelf crammed with thick law code books and a simple desk beside the window with one desk lamp, a laptop, highlighter pens in a cup and a swivel chair. Ahead, a sliding double window with a half-raised white roller blind, looking down on a lakeside park lawn with a few streetlights. On the right wall, a narrow single bed with plain light bedding. Ivory wallpaper, light wood-look vinyl floor, tidy but cramped student life.
- 화면·연출: 가로 3분할. ① 하린의 맨등과 날개뼈 너머로 그의 손바닥이 옆구리에서 가슴의 둥근 곡선을 감싼 실루엣, 곡선은 하린의 팔과 어둠이 가리고 그의 입술은 쇄골에서 곡선을 따라 내려간다. ② 책상 모서리를 움켜쥔 하린의 손 옆으로 노란 형광펜이 데구루루 굴러 떨어지고, 반바지가 허벅지를 따라 미끄러져 발목에 걸린다. ③ 그의 손바닥은 무릎 위에 머물고, 하린의 손이 그의 허리띠를 잡아당겨 버클이 법전 모서리에 부딪힌다. 효과음은 붓 효과음(East Sea Dokdo), ② 작게, ③ 크게.

A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. Habits: pushes up glasses that are already up; slightly hunched student posture that straightens when her hair is tied; bursts out laughing.

On the left wall, a bookshelf crammed with thick law code books and a simple desk beside the window with one desk lamp, a laptop, highlighter pens in a cup and a swivel chair. Ahead, a sliding double window with a half-raised white roller blind, looking down on a lakeside park lawn with a few streetlights. On the right wall, a narrow single bed with plain light bedding. Ivory wallpaper, light wood-look vinyl floor, tidy but cramped student life.

- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. ## 3-025 (3화. 첫 연애 / S#4 너한테만 하는 얘긴데 (412동 502호, 9월 12일 토 새벽 4:50))

Korean adult webtoon, semi-realistic glossy digital painting, soft airbrush gradient shading, gentle rim light, fine thin warm-brown lineart, 8-head proportions, cinematic lighting, detailed fabric rendering (silk sheen, velvet depth, knit texture), smooth luminous skin, clean background painting with soft bokeh, vertical webtoon panel composition, no text, no watermark, no logos.
- 캔버스: 800×1200 (세로 스크롤 컷)
- 시대·장소: 2026년 9~10월, 한국 경기도 호수 신도시의 2024년 준공 신축 대단지 '레이크시티 더퍼스트'(가상, 15개 동 3,012세대)와 단지 상가·커뮤니티. 에필로그는 2027년 2월 수원지방법원 형사법정, 2029년 10월 교도소 정문과 새솔신도시 모델하우스(가상). 스마트폰·메신저·스마트워치가 있는 현재.

- 장소 고정값:
- 장소 4 412동 502호 — 하린의 전세방 — SET LOCK: A small rented room in unit 502 on the 5th floor of a new 2024-built Korean apartment building, a law student's room about 3 by 3.6 meters. On the left wall, a bookshelf crammed with thick law code books and a simple desk beside the window with one desk lamp, a laptop, highlighter pens in a cup and a swivel chair. Ahead, a sliding double window with a half-raised white roller blind, looking down on a lakeside park lawn with a few streetlights. On the right wall, a narrow single bed with plain light bedding. Ivory wallpaper, light wood-look vinyl floor, tidy but cramped student life.
- 화면·연출: 방 문가(C1). 창밖 하늘이 남색에서 잿빛으로 묽어지고 스탠드는 여전히 노랗다. 왼쪽 책상 의자에 그의 흰 셔츠만 입은 하린이 앉아 맨다리 두 개를 의자 밖으로 길게 뻗고, 노트북 화면에 상환 일정표와 통장 잔액 20,000,000원(식자)이 떠 있다. 오른쪽 침대에는 시트를 허리까지 덮은 도겸이 천장을 보고 누워 있다. 효과음은 붓 효과음(East Sea Dokdo), 창밖 위쪽에 작게.
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 하린: Yoon Ha-rin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. Habits: pushes up glasses that are already up; slightly hunched student posture that straightens when her hair is tied; bursts out laughing.

## 3-030 (3화. 첫 연애 / S#4 너한테만 하는 얘긴데 (412동 502호, 9월 12일 토 새벽 4:50))

- 장소 고정값:
- 장소 4 412동 502호 — 하린의 전세방 — SET LOCK: A small rented room in unit 502 on the 5th floor of a new 2024-built Korean apartment building, a law student's room about 3 by 3.6 meters. On the left wall, a bookshelf crammed with thick law code books and a simple desk beside the window with one desk lamp, a laptop, highlighter pens in a cup and a swivel chair. Ahead, a sliding double window with a half-raised white roller blind, looking down on a lakeside park lawn with a few streetlights. On the right wall, a narrow single bed with plain light bedding. Ivory wallpaper, light wood-look vinyl floor, tidy but cramped student life.
- 화면·연출: 첫 말풍선은 누운 채, 두 번째 말풍선은 그가 몸을 일으키는 동작에 맞춰 위로 올라간다. 맨어깨와 쇄골에 스탠드 불빛이 얹히고 창의 잿빛이 반대편 윤곽을 만든다. 그는 하린을 똑바로 본다.
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 하린: Yoon Ha-rin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. Habits: pushes up glasses that are already up; slightly hunched student posture that straightens when her hair is tied; bursts out laughing.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).
- 말풍선·글자는 이미지에 넣지 말 것 (레터링은 후공정)

Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. ## 3-035 (3화. 첫 연애 / S#5 사기와 공갈의 죄 (412동 502호 현관 / 책상, 9월 12일 토 새벽 5:30 → 오전 9:00))

Korean adult webtoon, semi-realistic glossy digital painting, soft airbrush gradient shading, gentle rim light, fine thin warm-brown lineart, 8-head proportions, cinematic lighting, detailed fabric rendering (silk sheen, velvet depth, knit texture), smooth luminous skin, clean background painting with soft bokeh, vertical webtoon panel composition, no text, no watermark, no logos.

- 시대·장소: 2026년 9~10월, 한국 경기도 호수 신도시의 2024년 준공 신축 대단지 '레이크시티 더퍼스트'(가상, 15개 동 3,012세대)와 단지 상가·커뮤니티. 에필로그는 2027년 2월 수원지방법원 형사법정, 2029년 10월 교도소 정문과 새솔신도시 모델하우스(가상). 스마트폰·메신저·스마트워치가 있는 현재.
- 장면 연출 메모(장소·조명·의상): 장소 4(현관, C2 책상 상판) / 조명: 새벽 5:30 스탠드 2700K + 창의 잿빛, 오전 9:00 남쪽 창 자연광 5500K에 스탠드 아직 켜짐 / 의상: 도겸 맨가슴에 네이비 재킷 #1F2C46·차콜 슬랙스 #2B2F3A, 하린 그의 흰 셔츠 #F4F4F2·9시에는 금테 타원 안경 / 트랙: 1 / 감정 목표: 남겨진 셔츠의 달콤함 위로 법전 페이지가 던지는 서늘한 아이러니.
- 장소 고정값:
- 장소 4 412동 502호 — 하린의 전세방 — SET LOCK: A small rented room in unit 502 on the 5th floor of a new 2024-built Korean apartment building, a law student's room about 3 by 3.6 meters. On the left wall, a bookshelf crammed with thick law code books and a simple desk beside the window with one desk lamp, a laptop, highlighter pens in a cup and a swivel chair. Ahead, a sliding double window with a half-raised white roller blind, looking down on a lakeside park lawn with a few streetlights. On the right wall, a narrow single bed with plain light bedding. Ivory wallpaper, light wood-look vinyl floor, tidy but cramped student life.
- 화면·연출: 현관. 맨가슴에 네이비 재킷만 걸친 도겸이 구두를 신으며 어깨 너머로 말한다. 방 문가에 그의 셔츠만 입은 하린이 셔츠 깃을 여미고 서 있다. 말풍선 우상.
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 하린: Yoon Ha-rin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. Habits: pushes up glasses that are already up; slightly hunched student posture that straightens when her hair is tied; bursts out laughing.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).
