- 장소 3 더퍼스트 클럽 지하 1층 — 필라테스룸·안내데스크 — SET LOCK: Basement pilates studio in the community center of a new Korean apartment complex, about 8 by 8.5 meters, no windows. The left wall is a full mirror wall of six tall panels with a thin LED light strip along the floor beneath it. Six oak-frame pilates reformers with charcoal carriages and red springs stand in one row, foot bars toward the mirror. Light oak flooring with black rubber mats, recessed ceiling downlights, two ventilation grilles high on the back wall. A glass door and glass partition on the near wall, a small instructor desk with a monitor and a coat stand in the corner by the door.
- 화면·연출: 남동 모서리(C1)에서 대각선으로 본 리포머 여섯 대와 거울 여섯 장. 야간 소그룹 네 명이 누워 있고 맨 끝(북쪽) 리포머의 하린이 작게 보이며, 그 사이를 세라가 척추를 세우고 소리 없이 걷는다. 빨간 스프링이 늘었다 줄고, 선반 스피커에 물결 음표 몇 개. 효과음은 붓 효과음(East Sea Dokdo).
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 세라: Oh Se-ra, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 28-year-old Korean woman, pilates instructor and former rhythmic gymnast, 168 cm. Toned athletic-curvy body: high, firm, rounded bust, defined abs, small waist, visible hip-bone lines, round firm glutes, strong outer thighs, straight legs, square shoulders with sharp shoulder blades. Two distinct Venus dimples on the lower back just above the waistband, her signature, visible in every back view. Heart-shaped face, bright round eyes, thick short straight brows, small slightly upturned nose with light freckles across the bridge, even full lips with only lip balm. Warm tan bronze skin (#D9A982). Black (#1C1F26) straight hair to mid-back tied in a high bouncy ponytail with loose baby hairs at the temples. Smartwatch on the left wrist, a hair tie, short clear nails, a small surgical scar on the inner left ankle. Habits: spine always upright, walks silently with the ponytail swinging, short laugh through the nose, stretches when annoyed.
- 하린: Yoon Ha-rin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. Habits: pushes up glasses that are already up; slightly hunched student posture that straightens when her hair is tied; bursts out laughing.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).

- 실제 브랜드 로고·엠블럼, 실제 화폐 도안, 법원·경찰·교도소 휘장 금지(로고 없는 시계, 퀼팅 체인 백, 도안 없는 소품용 지폐)
- 이미지 안에 말풍선·글자·간판 문구를 넣지 않는다(레터링은 후공정)

- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다
- 허용: 몸 라인이 드러나는 의상, 속옷·슬립, 옷이 벗겨지는 과정, 드러난 등·어깨·쇄골·허리·허벅지, 시트로 가린 나신, 역광 실루엣, 손과 입술, 땀과 숨
- 금지: 성기, 유두 노출, 삽입·성행위의 직접 묘사, 체액
- 생성기가 거절하면 가림 소품(시트·커튼·와인잔·셔츠 자락) → 실루엣 → 손·입술·사물 인서트 순서로 바꾼다

Light oak flooring with black rubber mats, recessed ceiling downlights, two ventilation grilles high on the back wall. Polished white marble floor throughout, warm white walls, minimal luxury interior. The living room's south wall is one floor-to-ceiling glass wall about 9 m wide, five panes with slim black mullions and a low marble sill, overlooking a wide calm lake far below with a lit lakeside promenade and a distant highway on the horizon. Grey fabric sofa, white ceramic kitchen island with two round pendant lamps. Master bedroom in the southeast corner with frameless corner glass on two sides, a king bed against the inner wall facing the glass.

A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.

Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.

- 시대·장소: 2026년 9~10월, 한국 경기도 호수 신도시의 2024년 준공 신축 대단지 '레이크시티 더퍼스트'(가상, 15개 동 3,012세대)와 단지 상가·커뮤니티. 에필로그는 2027년 2월 수원지방법원 형사법정, 2029년 10월 교도소 정문과 새솔신도시 모델하우스(가상). 스마트폰·메신저·스마트워치가 있는 현재.

A circular light-grey granite splash pad about 14 m wide with two rings of ground fountain nozzles. On the left, a colorful play structure with two slides above a sand pit edged with granite. On the right, a half-circle of wooden benches under a pergola and one tall lamppost with a cylindrical announcement speaker. Zelkova trees and lawn mounds around it; beyond a gate to the southeast, a wide calm lake with a lakeside promenade.

The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.

Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.

A circular light-grey granite splash pad about 14 m wide with two rings of ground fountain nozzles. On the left, a colorful play structure with two slides above a sand pit edged with granite. On the right, a half-circle of wooden benches under a pergola and one tall lamppost with a cylindrical announcement speaker. Zelkova trees and lawn mounds around it; beyond a gate to the southeast, a wide calm lake with a lakeside promenade.

Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. - 유진: Seo Yu-jin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 33-year-old Korean woman, former flight attendant, 172 cm, the tallest woman of the cast. Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.
- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. A circular light-grey granite splash pad about 14 m wide with two rings of ground fountain nozzles. On the left, a colorful play structure with two slides above a sand pit edged with granite. On the right, a half-circle of wooden benches under a pergola and one tall lamppost with a cylindrical announcement speaker. Zelkova trees and lawn mounds around it; beyond a gate to the southeast, a wide calm lake with a lakeside promenade.

- 유진: Seo Yu-jin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 33-year-old Korean woman, former flight attendant, 172 cm, the tallest woman of the cast. Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. A circular light-grey granite splash pad about 14 m wide with two rings of ground fountain nozzles. On the left, a colorful play structure with two slides above a sand pit edged with granite. On the right, a half-circle of wooden benches under a pergola and one tall lamppost with a cylindrical announcement speaker. Zelkova trees and lawn mounds around it; beyond a gate to the southeast, a wide calm lake with a lakeside promenade.
- 화면·연출: 위아래 2분할. 위: 3-095와 같은 구도, 휴대폰을 귀에서 반쯤 내린 두 여자가 하얀 여백 속에서 마침내 서로를 향해 고개를 돌려 눈이 마주치고, 그 순간 배경에 색이 돌아오며 뒤편 바닥분수가 다시 솟고 뛰는 아이들 실루엣이 작게 보인다. 아래: 유진의 무릎 위 휴대폰 INS, 통화 종료 화면(가상 UI, '0:41'은 식자) 위로 분수 물방울 그림자가 어른거린다. 효과음은 붓 효과음(East Sea Dokdo)으로 위칸 분수 쪽, 내레이션 박스는 위칸 좌상과 아래칸 우상.
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 유진: Seo Yu-jin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 33-year-old Korean woman, former flight attendant, 172 cm, the tallest woman of the cast. Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.
- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.

Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. The living room faces west through a 4.2 m window with sheer burgundy curtains and a narrow unextended balcony beyond. A sofa on the left wall, a TV on the right, a basket of a seven-year-old girl's toys on the floor. To the right of the entry, an open kitchen with a solid wood four-seat dining table and a small wine rack on the wall. Light wood floor, cream walls, lived-in and warm.

- 유진: Seo Yu-jin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 33-year-old Korean woman, former flight attendant, 172 cm, the tallest woman of the cast. Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.
- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.

The living room's south wall is one floor-to-ceiling glass wall about 9 m wide, five panes with slim black mullions and a low marble sill, overlooking a wide calm lake far below with a lit lakeside promenade and a distant highway on the horizon. Grey fabric sofa, white ceramic kitchen island with two round pendant lamps. Master bedroom in the southeast corner with frameless corner glass on two sides, a king bed against the inner wall facing the glass.

Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Behind the counter, a back-bar shelf with a blank chalkboard menu. Along the left wall: a small round marble corner table near the front, a burgundy velvet Chesterfield sofa, and two tall glass-door wine cellars at the back. Dark burgundy hexagon floor tiles, wooden louver blinds on the front glass.

Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.

The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.
- 세라: Oh Se-ra, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 28-year-old Korean woman, pilates instructor and former rhythmic gymnast, 168 cm. Toned athletic-curvy body: high, firm, rounded bust, defined abs, small waist, visible hip-bone lines, round firm glutes, strong outer thighs, straight legs, square shoulders with sharp shoulder blades. Two distinct Venus dimples on the lower back just above the waistband, her signature, visible in every back view. Heart-shaped face, bright round eyes, thick short straight brows, small slightly upturned nose with light freckles across the bridge, even full lips with only lip balm. Warm tan bronze skin (#D9A982). Black (#1C1F26) straight hair to mid-back tied in a high bouncy ponytail with loose baby hairs at the temples. Smartwatch on the left wrist, a hair tie, short clear nails, a small surgical scar on the inner left ankle. Habits: spine always upright, walks silently with the ponytail swinging, short laugh through the nose, stretches when annoyed.
- 하린: Yoon Ha-rin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. Habits: pushes up glasses that are already up; slightly hunched student posture that straightens when her hair is tied; bursts out laughing.
- 혜숙: Jeong Hye-suk, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 42-year-old Korean woman, elegant wealthy housewife and residents' association president, 166 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Warm mature hourglass with weight: full heavy bust, softly cinched waist, wide round hips, smooth calves in sheer stockings, a long graceful neck; a slow, low-centered, unhurried body. Soft rounded face with a still-firm jawline and fine smile lines at the eyes; long narrow eyes with elegant winged eyeliner; high thin painted arched brows; straight nose; plump wine-red lips. Well-kept skin (#F0CDB4). Dark chocolate hair (#2B1D16) in a loose low chignon at the nape with a few strands falling. Signature: a single strand of 44 pearls restrung on a visibly new bright-white silk thread, pearl stud earrings, glossy red nails, a faint pale mark on the bare left ring finger. Habits: covers her mouth with her hand when she smiles, fingers drift up to the pearls, looks down with her chin raised, perches on the edges of beds and tables.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).

## 4-083 (4화. 비밀방 / S#16 너한테만 하는 얘긴데 (와인바 '미란', 9월 22일 화 밤 11:00))

Behind the counter, a back-bar shelf with a blank chalkboard menu. Along the left wall: a small round marble corner table near the front, a burgundy velvet Chesterfield sofa, and two tall glass-door wine cellars at the back. Dark burgundy hexagon floor tiles, wooden louver blinds on the front glass.

Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.
- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.
- 세라: Oh Se-ra, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 28-year-old Korean woman, pilates instructor and former rhythmic gymnast, 168 cm. Toned athletic-curvy body: high, firm, rounded bust, defined abs, small waist, visible hip-bone lines, round firm glutes, strong outer thighs, straight legs, square shoulders with sharp shoulder blades. Two distinct Venus dimples on the lower back just above the waistband, her signature, visible in every back view. Heart-shaped face, bright round eyes, thick short straight brows, small slightly upturned nose with light freckles across the bridge, even full lips with only lip balm. Warm tan bronze skin (#D9A982). Black (#1C1F26) straight hair to mid-back tied in a high bouncy ponytail with loose baby hairs at the temples. Smartwatch on the left wrist, a hair tie, short clear nails, a small surgical scar on the inner left ankle. Habits: spine always upright, walks silently with the ponytail swinging, short laugh through the nose, stretches when annoyed.
- 하린: Yoon Ha-rin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. Habits: pushes up glasses that are already up; slightly hunched student posture that straightens when her hair is tied; bursts out laughing.
- 혜숙: Jeong Hye-suk, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 42-year-old Korean woman, elegant wealthy housewife and residents' association president, 166 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Warm mature hourglass with weight: full heavy bust, softly cinched waist, wide round hips, smooth calves in sheer stockings, a long graceful neck; a slow, low-centered, unhurried body. Soft rounded face with a still-firm jawline and fine smile lines at the eyes; long narrow eyes with elegant winged eyeliner; high thin painted arched brows; straight nose; plump wine-red lips. Well-kept skin (#F0CDB4). Dark chocolate hair (#2B1D16) in a loose low chignon at the nape with a few strands falling. Signature: a single strand of 44 pearls restrung on a visibly new bright-white silk thread, pearl stud earrings, glossy red nails, a faint pale mark on the bare left ring finger. Habits: covers her mouth with her hand when she smiles, fingers drift up to the pearls, looks down with her chin raised, perches on the edges of beds and tables.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).

- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 유진: Seo Yu-jin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 33-year-old Korean woman, former flight attendant, 172 cm, the tallest woman of the cast. Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.
- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.
- 세라: Oh Se-ra, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 28-year-old Korean woman, pilates instructor and former rhythmic gymnast, 168 cm. Toned athletic-curvy body: high, firm, rounded bust, defined abs, small waist, visible hip-bone lines, round firm glutes, strong outer thighs, straight legs, square shoulders with sharp shoulder blades. Two distinct Venus dimples on the lower back just above the waistband, her signature, visible in every back view. Heart-shaped face, bright round eyes, thick short straight brows, small slightly upturned nose with light freckles across the bridge, even full lips with only lip balm. Warm tan bronze skin (#D9A982). Black (#1C1F26) straight hair to mid-back tied in a high bouncy ponytail with loose baby hairs at the temples. Smartwatch on the left wrist, a hair tie, short clear nails, a small surgical scar on the inner left ankle. Habits: spine always upright, walks silently with the ponytail swinging, short laugh through the nose, stretches when annoyed.
- 하린: Yoon Ha-rin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. Habits: pushes up glasses that are already up; slightly hunched student posture that straightens when her hair is tied; bursts out laughing.
- 혜숙: Jeong Hye-suk, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 42-year-old Korean woman, elegant wealthy housewife and residents' association president, 166 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Warm mature hourglass with weight: full heavy bust, softly cinched waist, wide round hips, smooth calves in sheer stockings, a long graceful neck; a slow, low-centered, unhurried body. Soft rounded face with a still-firm jawline and fine smile lines at the eyes; long narrow eyes with elegant winged eyeliner; high thin painted arched brows; straight nose; plump wine-red lips. Well-kept skin (#F0CDB4). Dark chocolate hair (#2B1D16) in a loose low chignon at the nape with a few strands falling. Signature: a single strand of 44 pearls restrung on a visibly new bright-white silk thread, pearl stud earrings, glossy red nails, a faint pale mark on the bare left ring finger. Habits: covers her mouth with her hand when she smiles, fingers drift up to the pearls, looks down with her chin raised, perches on the edges of beds and tables.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).
- 말풍선·글자는 이미지에 넣지 말 것 (레터링은 후공정)

**레터링(후공정)**
  - [narration] 내레이션: 다섯 개의 목소리가 한 박자도 어긋나지 않았다.
  - [dialogue] 다섯: 나 사실 아버지랑 사이 안 좋아. 회사 물려받기 싫어.

**금지·수위**
- 모든 얼굴은 창작된 성인 — 실존 인물·유명인과 닮게 만들지 않는다(실화 모티프 작품)
- 실제 브랜드 로고·엠블럼, 실제 화폐 도안, 법원·경찰·교도소 휘장 금지(로고 없는 시계, 퀼팅 체인 백, 도안 없는 소품용 지폐)
- 이미지 안에 말풍선·글자·간판 문구를 넣지 않는다(레터링은 후공정)

- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다
- 허용: 몸 라인이 드러나는 의상, 속옷·슬립, 옷이 벗겨지는 과정, 드러난 등·어깨·쇄골·허리·허벅지, 시트로 가린 나신, 역광 실루엣, 손과 입술, 땀과 숨
- 금지: 성기, 유두 노출, 삽입·성행위의 직접 묘사, 체액
- 생성기가 거절하면 가림 소품(시트·커튼·와인잔·셔츠 자락) → 실루엣 → 손·입술·사물 인서트 순서로 바꾼다

## 4-085 (4화. 비밀방 / S#16 너한테만 하는 얘긴데 (와인바 '미란', 9월 22일 화 밤 11:00))
- 샷·앵글·인물: LS · 아이레벨 · 혜숙(좌), 미란(좌), 세라(중), 하린(우), 유진(우)
**이미지 프롬프트**
Korean adult webtoon, semi-realistic glossy digital painting, soft airbrush gradient shading, gentle rim light, fine thin warm-brown lineart, 8-head proportions, cinematic lighting, detailed fabric rendering (silk sheen, velvet depth, knit texture), smooth luminous skin, clean background painting with soft bokeh, vertical webtoon panel composition, no text, no watermark, no logos.
- 캔버스: 800×1800 (세로 스크롤 컷)
- 시대·장소: 2026년 9~10월, 한국 경기도 호수 신도시의 2024년 준공 신축 대단지 '레이크시티 더퍼스트'(가상, 15개 동 3,012세대)와 단지 상가·커뮤니티. 에필로그는 2027년 2월 수원지방법원 형사법정, 2029년 10월 교도소 정문과 새솔신도시 모델하우스(가상). 스마트폰·메신저·스마트워치가 있는 현재.
- 장면 연출 메모(장소·조명·의상): 장소 2(와인바 '미란', 카메라 C1 정문 안쪽·C2 카운터 안쪽) · 조명: 블라인드 끝까지 내림, 정문에 'CLOSED' 팻말(빈 면, 식자), 붉은 펜던트 다섯 개를 모두 켜 카운터 위에 일렬로 다섯 여자 머리 위에 하나씩 붉은 원뿔, 셀러 LED 4000K가 왼쪽 벽 끝에 차갑게 · 좌석(C2에서 보아 왼쪽부터): 혜숙·미란·세라·하린·유진(뒤집는 순서와 같고, 아내의 패는 맨 끝) · 의상(대표 색 규칙: 각자의 색이 옷이나 소품 한 곳에 반드시): 혜숙 샴페인 골드 실크 블라우스(콘티 지정, #C9A45C 계열)·검정 펜슬스커트 #17171A·새 실 진주 한 줄·빨간 손톱 / 미란 흰 오프숄더 블라우스 #F5F1EA·검정 슬릿 롱스커트 #1A1718(bible '같은 계열')·붉은 립·와인색 손톱 #5A1A26·버건디 와인 병과 잔(대표 색 버건디) / 세라 민트 집업 #7FD1BE(앞을 연 채)·회색 크롭 브라톱 #8D9096·검정 레깅스 #1B1C1F·하이 포니테일·스마트워치 / 하린 하늘색 오버핏 셔츠(콘티 지정, #9CC7E8 계열)·차콜 니트 미니스커트 #3A3D44·금테 타원 안경·높이 묶은 생머리 / 유진 라이트 그레이 니트 셋업 #BFC1C4(회색 계열)·진주 스터드 · 회상 인서트 다섯 컷(4-072, 4-074, 4-076, 4-078, 4-080)은 프레이밍·크기·키라이트·도겸의 의상과 동작을 똑같이 반복하고, 바뀌는 것은 대표 색 틴트와 배경 소품뿐 · 트랙: 1(4-077, 4-082, 4-084는 트랙2) · 감정 목표: 같은 문장이 다섯 번 뒤집히는 반복의 리듬과 블랙코미디의 웃음, 그리고 다섯 목소리가 겹치는 순간 웃음이 끊기며 '대본'이 드러난다.

Behind the counter, a back-bar shelf with a blank chalkboard menu. Along the left wall: a small round marble corner table near the front, a burgundy velvet Chesterfield sofa, and two tall glass-door wine cellars at the back. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. The living room's south wall is one floor-to-ceiling glass wall about 9 m wide, five panes with slim black mullions and a low marble sill, overlooking a wide calm lake far below with a lit lakeside promenade and a distant highway on the horizon. Grey fabric sofa, white ceramic kitchen island with two round pendant lamps. Master bedroom in the southeast corner with frameless corner glass on two sides, a king bed against the inner wall facing the glass.

- 장소 2 와인바 '미란' — 퍼스트 애비뉴 1층 — SET LOCK: Small Korean wine bar called Miran on the ground floor of a new apartment complex shopping street, about 7 m wide and 12 m deep. A dark walnut bar counter 6 m long runs along the right wall with six bar stools, an overhead rack of upside-down wine glasses, and five red glass pendant lamps in a row above it. Behind the counter, a back-bar shelf with a blank chalkboard menu. Along the left wall: a small round marble corner table near the front, a burgundy velvet Chesterfield sofa, and two tall glass-door wine cellars at the back. Dark burgundy hexagon floor tiles, wooden louver blinds on the front glass.
- 화면·연출: 위아래 2단. 위: 웃음 그대로 미란이 스툴 위 그의 무릎에 올라앉고, 랩 자락이 갈라져 풍만한 허벅지가 붉게 드러난다(하이힐이 발걸이에 걸림). 아래 INS: 그가 늘 풀어 두는 두 개 아래, 세 번째 단추부터 와인색 손톱이 하나씩 푼다(손의 잔상 셋, 단추마다 숨 효과선). 효과음은 붓 효과음(East Sea Dokdo), 내레이션 아래칸 우하.

- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.

- 장소 2 와인바 '미란' — 퍼스트 애비뉴 1층 — SET LOCK: Small Korean wine bar called Miran on the ground floor of a new apartment complex shopping street, about 7 m wide and 12 m deep. A dark walnut bar counter 6 m long runs along the right wall with six bar stools, an overhead rack of upside-down wine glasses, and five red glass pendant lamps in a row above it. Behind the counter, a back-bar shelf with a blank chalkboard menu. Along the left wall: a small round marble corner table near the front, a burgundy velvet Chesterfield sofa, and two tall glass-door wine cellars at the back. Dark burgundy hexagon floor tiles, wooden louver blinds on the front glass.
- 화면·연출: 그의 손바닥이 미란의 맨등을 타고 내려가다 허리의 오목한 곳에서 멈춘다(시계와 흉터, 펴진 채 정지한 손가락). 붉은 하이라이트가 척추 골을 따라 흐르고 흘러내린 저지가 허리 아래를 덮는다. 내레이션 하단.

A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.

Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.

## 5-060 (5화. 역관리 / S#10 오늘은 내가 세요 (207동 803호 원룸 요가 매트 위, 10월 3일 토 밤, S#9에서 연속))
- 샷·앵글·인물: MS · 측면 · 세라(중·실루엣), 도겸(하단)
**이미지 프롬프트**
Korean adult webtoon, semi-realistic glossy digital painting, soft airbrush gradient shading, gentle rim light, fine thin warm-brown lineart, 8-head proportions, cinematic lighting, detailed fabric rendering (silk sheen, velvet depth, knit texture), smooth luminous skin, clean background painting with soft bokeh, vertical webtoon panel composition, no text, no watermark, no logos.
- 캔버스: 800×1560 (세로 스크롤 컷)
- 시대·장소: 2026년 9~10월, 한국 경기도 호수 신도시의 2024년 준공 신축 대단지 '레이크시티 더퍼스트'(가상, 15개 동 3,012세대)와 단지 상가·커뮤니티. 에필로그는 2027년 2월 수원지방법원 형사법정, 2029년 10월 교도소 정문과 새솔신도시 모델하우스(가상). 스마트폰·메신저·스마트워치가 있는 현재.
- 장면 연출 메모(장소·조명·의상): 장소 짧게 B(요가 매트 위, 카메라 C2 매트 높이 중심) · 조명: 머리맡 간접등 하나 2400K 주황, 낮게 옆에서, 몸은 측면 실루엣과 땀 하이라이트만 · 의상: 세라 민트 브라톱 #8FD8C4(벗음)·검정 레깅스 #1B1C1F(벗겨짐)·젖은 포니테일·스마트워치 / 도겸 흰 셔츠 #F4F4F2(머리 위로 벗겨져 소매에 두 팔이 걸림)·차콜 슬랙스·시계와 흉터 · 수위 장치(sets B-6): 간접등 측면 실루엣, 매트 끝·폼롤러·침대 모서리 전경, 세탁기와 스마트워치 화면으로 컷 넘기기, 거울 금지 · 트랙: 1 · 감정 목표: 그녀의 카운트가 그의 속도를 소유한다. 세트처럼 쌓다 셋, 둘, 하나로 짧아지고 끝에서 숫자가 사라진다. 손목 화면을 확인하는 눈이 사이사이 끼어든다.
- 장소 고정값:
- 장소 짧게 B 207동 803호 — 세라의 집 — SET LOCK: A tiny rented studio, unit 803 on the 8th floor of a small-unit building in a new 2024-built Korean apartment complex, about 3.2 by 5 meters, ten steps from wall to wall. A double bed against the right wall with a small warm indirect lamp on the headboard shelf, a single yoga mat on the floor in the middle with a foam roller and a small kettlebell, a mini kitchen and bathroom door on the left, a window ahead onto a tiny balcony holding a washing machine. A clothes rack by the door with athletic wear. Absolutely no mirrors anywhere in the room.
- 화면·연출: 천이 머리를 빠져나가고 포니테일이 등 뒤로 떨어지며 날개뼈를 친다. 벗겨진 천을 쥔 채 내리는 팔뚝이 가슴 앞선을 가리고, 측면 주황 빛이 구릿빛 어깨·쇄골·오르내리는 복근 옆선에만 하이라이트를 남기며 앞면은 그늘(전경에 흐린 폼롤러). 세라가 소매가 감긴 그의 손을 끌어다 자기 허리에 얹고 손등을 한 번 눌러 고정한다. 효과음은 붓 효과음(East Sea Dokdo), 내레이션 상단과 하단.
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 세라: Oh Se-ra, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 28-year-old Korean woman, pilates instructor and former rhythmic gymnast, 168 cm. Toned athletic-curvy body: high, firm, rounded bust, defined abs, small waist, visible hip-bone lines, round firm glutes, strong outer thighs, straight legs, square shoulders with sharp shoulder blades. Two distinct Venus dimples on the lower back just above the waistband, her signature, visible in every back view. Heart-shaped face, bright round eyes, thick short straight brows, small slightly upturned nose with light freckles across the bridge, even full lips with only lip balm. Warm tan bronze skin (#D9A982). Black (#1C1F26) straight hair to mid-back tied in a high bouncy ponytail with loose baby hairs at the temples. Smartwatch on the left wrist, a hair tie, short clear nails, a small surgical scar on the inner left ankle. Habits: spine always upright, walks silently with the ponytail swinging, short laugh through the nose, stretches when annoyed.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).
- 말풍선·글자는 이미지에 넣지 말 것 (레터링은 후공정)

**레터링(후공정)**
  - [sfx] SFX(중간): 철썩
  - [narration] 내레이션: 구릿빛 어깨, 단단한 가슴의 곡선, 숨 쉴 때마다 오르내리는 복근.
  - [narration] 내레이션: 딱 거기까지만 허락했다.

**금지·수위**
- 모든 얼굴은 창작된 성인 — 실존 인물·유명인과 닮게 만들지 않는다(실화 모티프 작품)
- 실제 브랜드 로고·엠블럼, 실제 화폐 도안, 법원·경찰·교도소 휘장 금지(로고 없는 시계, 퀼팅 체인 백, 도안 없는 소품용 지폐)
- 이미지 안에 말풍선·글자·간판 문구를 넣지 않는다(레터링은 후공정)
- 미성년으로 보이는 표현 금지 — 하린(25)은 성인 체형·성숙한 표정
- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다
- 허용: 몸 라인이 드러나는 의상, 속옷·슬립, 옷이 벗겨지는 과정, 드러난 등·어깨·쇄골·허리·허벅지, 시트로 가린 나신, 역광 실루엣, 손과 입술, 땀과 숨
- 금지: 성기, 유두 노출, 삽입·성행위의 직접 묘사, 체액
- 생성기가 거절하면 가림 소품(시트·커튼·와인잔·셔츠 자락) → 실루엣 → 손·입술·사물 인서트 순서로 바꾼다

- 장소 고정값:
- 장소 짧게 B 207동 803호 — 세라의 집 — SET LOCK: A tiny rented studio, unit 803 on the 8th floor of a small-unit building in a new 2024-built Korean apartment complex, about 3.2 by 5 meters, ten steps from wall to wall. A double bed against the right wall with a small warm indirect lamp on the headboard shelf, a single yoga mat on the floor in the middle with a foam roller and a small kettlebell, a mini kitchen and bathroom door on the left, a window ahead onto a tiny balcony holding a washing machine. A clothes rack by the door with athletic wear. Absolutely no mirrors anywhere in the room.
- 화면·연출: 가로 4분할의 같은 구도. 스마트워치 심박 숫자가 칸마다 오른다(식자). 세라는 어깨·턱선 실루엣만 메트로놈 같은 같은 간격으로 낮아졌다 높아진다(가슴 아래는 프레임 밖). 4칸에서 그가 박자를 앞당기려 들썩이자 그녀의 손바닥이 그의 어깨를 매트에 붙드는 압력선. 내레이션은 네 칸 위를 가로지른다.
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 세라: Oh Se-ra, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 28-year-old Korean woman, pilates instructor and former rhythmic gymnast, 168 cm. Toned athletic-curvy body: high, firm, rounded bust, defined abs, small waist, visible hip-bone lines, round firm glutes, strong outer thighs, straight legs, square shoulders with sharp shoulder blades. Two distinct Venus dimples on the lower back just above the waistband, her signature, visible in every back view. Heart-shaped face, bright round eyes, thick short straight brows, small slightly upturned nose with light freckles across the bridge, even full lips with only lip balm. Warm tan bronze skin (#D9A982). Black (#1C1F26) straight hair to mid-back tied in a high bouncy ponytail with loose baby hairs at the temples. Smartwatch on the left wrist, a hair tie, short clear nails, a small surgical scar on the inner left ankle. Habits: spine always upright, walks silently with the ponytail swinging, short laugh through the nose, stretches when annoyed.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).
- 말풍선·글자는 이미지에 넣지 말 것 (레터링은 후공정)

**레터링(후공정)**
  - [narration] 내레이션: 그녀가 숫자를 셌다. 넷에 내려가고 넷에 올라왔다.

**금지·수위**
- 모든 얼굴은 창작된 성인 — 실존 인물·유명인과 닮게 만들지 않는다(실화 모티프 작품)
- 실제 브랜드 로고·엠블럼, 실제 화폐 도안, 법원·경찰·교도소 휘장 금지(로고 없는 시계, 퀼팅 체인 백, 도안 없는 소품용 지폐)
- 이미지 안에 말풍선·글자·간판 문구를 넣지 않는다(레터링은 후공정)
- 미성년으로 보이는 표현 금지 — 하린(25)은 성인 체형·성숙한 표정
- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다
- 허용: 몸 라인이 드러나는 의상, 속옷·슬립, 옷이 벗겨지는 과정, 드러난 등·어깨·쇄골·허리·허벅지, 시트로 가린 나신, 역광 실루엣, 손과 입술, 땀과 숨
- 금지: 성기, 유두 노출, 삽입·성행위의 직접 묘사, 체액
- 생성기가 거절하면 가림 소품(시트·커튼·와인잔·셔츠 자락) → 실루엣 → 손·입술·사물 인서트 순서로 바꾼다
- 참고 썸네일: thumbs/5-062.svg

Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. - 장소 고정값:
- 장소 7 더퍼스트 클럽 사우나 — 여탕 세신실·열탕 — SET LOCK: The scrub corner of a women's bathhouse in the basement sauna of a new Korean apartment complex community center. Wet pale aqua-white tiles on walls and floor, thick white steam hanging everywhere, round ceiling lights glowing like blurred moons through the steam, no windows. Two scrub tables covered with clear plastic sheets, plastic basins and dippers stacked on a wall shelf, a bar of mugwort soap, folded white towels. Right beside the scrub corner, a hot bath with a tiled rim to sit on and water circulating from a spout; a row of low seated shower stations along the far wall, a frosted glass half partition.
- 화면·연출: 위아래 2단. 위: 등 위의 굵은 손이 반 박자 늦게 내려간다(잔상 간격이 한 칸 벌어짐). 아래: 순옥이 대야 물을 등에 끼얹고 김이 일어난다. 내레이션 위칸 상단, 효과음은 아래칸 붓 효과음(East Sea Dokdo).
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 유진: Seo Yu-jin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 33-year-old Korean woman, former flight attendant, 172 cm, the tallest woman of the cast. Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.
- 순옥: Park Sun-ok, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 61-year-old Korean woman, a bathhouse body-scrub attendant for forty years, 155 cm, a compact 6.5-head build, shorter and sturdier than the rest of the cast. Solid working body: broad shoulders, thick forearms, thick calves, a slightly stooped back, plain unglamorous figure. Round face with cheeks flushed by steam and sun; THICK STRAIGHT dark eyebrows, the same family brows as her son; small droopy eyes; a wide nose; thin lips always pressed shut. Weathered warm skin (#E3B48E) with a reddish steam flush, lined by age and labor. Short graying permed bob (#8E8A86), under a mesh hair cap at work. Signature: thick, firm, warm hands with big knuckles, scrub-mitt calluses on the palms, very short water-softened nails, a pain-relief patch on the right wrist. Habits: silent, eyes lowered to towels, backs and hands; folds a towel in half and in half again with all four corners matching. Never sensual, always dignified.

Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. Habits: pushes up glasses that are already up; slightly hunched student posture that straightens when her hair is tied; bursts out laughing.

  - [dialogue] 하린: 오늘은 공부해야 돼요. 내일 형소법 쪽지시험이에요.

- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다
- 허용: 몸 라인이 드러나는 의상, 속옷·슬립, 옷이 벗겨지는 과정, 드러난 등·어깨·쇄골·허리·허벅지, 시트로 가린 나신, 역광 실루엣, 손과 입술, 땀과 숨
- 금지: 성기, 유두 노출, 삽입·성행위의 직접 묘사, 체액
- 생성기가 거절하면 가림 소품(시트·커튼·와인잔·셔츠 자락) → 실루엣 → 손·입술·사물 인서트 순서로 바꾼다

Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. A low concrete ceiling with exposed ducts and jet fans, two long rows of linear tube lights, square concrete columns wrapped with orange zone bands at waist height, a glossy green epoxy floor with white parking lines, slightly wet and reflective. An exit ramp curving upward at the far end. Behind, a glass automatic door into a bright elevator lobby and the mouth of a long white underground corridor that links the fifteen apartment buildings. Cool, humming, damp and empty.
- 화면·연출: 503동 B2 엘리베이터 홀 설정샷(C4, 엘리베이터 문 정면). 유리 자동문을 막 지나온 도겸의 젖은 등과 상자 넷이 전경에 걸리고, 열린 엘리베이터 안 밝은 빛 속에 부녀회 임원 셋이 2화와 같은 배열로 서 있다(파일을 안은 고미숙, 가운데 남정애, 휴대폰을 든 백지연). 천장 돔 CCTV, 흰 대형 타일. 도착음은 붓 효과음(East Sea Dokdo), 내레이션 박스 좌상과 우하.

- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).

## 6-021 (6화. 생일 / S#4 어머니가 몇 분 (지하 2층 연결통로 → 503동 지하 엘리베이터 홀, 10월 16일 금 저녁 6:44~6:47))
- 샷·앵글·인물: MS · 아이레벨 · 도겸(중), 고미숙(좌), 남정애(후경·중), 백지연(우)
**이미지 프롬프트**
Korean webtoon comedic reaction panel, bold black ink outlines 3-4px, flat two-tone cel shading, high-saturation flat colors, simple speed lines or focus lines, slightly exaggerated expression (chibi-lite deformation allowed only for the face and hands), same character design and outfit colors as the main style, plain flat color background, no text.
- 캔버스: 800×840 (세로 스크롤 컷)
- 시대·장소: 2026년 9~10월, 한국 경기도 호수 신도시의 2024년 준공 신축 대단지 '레이크시티 더퍼스트'(가상, 15개 동 3,012세대)와 단지 상가·커뮤니티. 에필로그는 2027년 2월 수원지방법원 형사법정, 2029년 10월 교도소 정문과 새솔신도시 모델하우스(가상). 스마트폰·메신저·스마트워치가 있는 현재.
- 장면 연출 메모(장소·조명·의상): 장소 8(동 연결통로 카메라 C3, 503동 B2 엘리베이터 홀 카메라 C4) · 조명: 연결통로는 형광등형 직관 등기구 한 줄 4500K가 위에서, 503동 B2 홀은 흰 대형 타일과 회색 포셀린 바닥에 천장 다운라이트 4500K(sets 8에 이 시각 줄 없음, 콘티 지정)와 열린 엘리베이터 안의 밝은 빛 · 의상: 도겸 S#1과 같음(셔츠 등판이 땀으로 젖음, 겨드랑이 상자 넷) / 고미숙 베이지 카디건·흑발 숏커트 #2A2422·돋보기 안경줄 / 남정애 꽃무늬 블라우스·뽀글 파마 #3B2A22 / 백지연 트렌치·밝은 브라운 레이어드컷 #6A4A35·손에 휴대폰 · 트랙: 2(6-018만 트랙1) · 감정 목표: 2화의 '어머니 심부름'이 그대로 되돌아오는 블랙코미디. 감사의 질문 하나에 말이 막히는 첫 균열.
- 장소 고정값:
- 장소 8 지하 2층 주차장 B구역·동 연결통로·엘리베이터 홀 — SET LOCK: Underground parking level B2, zone B, of a new 2024-built Korean mega apartment complex. A low concrete ceiling with exposed ducts and jet fans, two long rows of linear tube lights, square concrete columns wrapped with orange zone bands at waist height, a glossy green epoxy floor with white parking lines, slightly wet and reflective. An exit ramp curving upward at the far end. Behind, a glass automatic door into a bright elevator lobby and the mouth of a long white underground corridor that links the fifteen apartment buildings. Cool, humming, damp and empty.
- 화면·연출: [트랙2] 엘리베이터 안. 문이 닫히고 도겸이 대답 없이 24 버튼을 누른다(버튼 불빛, 숫자는 식자). 양옆과 뒤에서 세 사람의 시선이 직선 효과선으로 꽂히고, 그는 닫힌 문만 보며 땀방울 셋을 흘린다. 문 위 층수 표시 B2에서 1, 2로(식자). 효과음 없이 숨 막히는 정적.
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).
- 말풍선·글자는 이미지에 넣지 말 것 (레터링은 후공정)

- 화면·연출: 문이 열리고 현관 다운라이트 아래 혜숙이 선다. 어깨를 드러낸 오프숄더 라인에서 시작된 금색 시퀸이 가슴의 굴곡을 따라 빛의 비늘처럼 일어섰다가, 허리에서 바짝 조여 엉덩이의 둥근 선을 그대로 본뜨고 무릎 아래까지 좁게 떨어진다. 진주 세 줄이 쇄골 위에 겹쳐 눕고, 낮게 틀어 올린 시뇽 아래 긴 목덜미에 몇 가닥이 흘러내린다. 뒤로 현관 콘솔의 백합과 금테 거울이 흐리다.
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 도겸: Han Do-gyeom, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 32-year-old Korean man, 182 cm, lean long-limbed build: broad straight shoulders, broad flat chest, waist clearly narrower than the shoulders, long hard forearms with visible veins and long calves; a night driver's body, not a gym body. Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 혜숙: Jeong Hye-suk, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 42-year-old Korean woman, elegant wealthy housewife and residents' association president, 166 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Warm mature hourglass with weight: full heavy bust, softly cinched waist, wide round hips, smooth calves in sheer stockings, a long graceful neck; a slow, low-centered, unhurried body. Soft rounded face with a still-firm jawline and fine smile lines at the eyes; long narrow eyes with elegant winged eyeliner; high thin painted arched brows; straight nose; plump wine-red lips. Well-kept skin (#F0CDB4). Dark chocolate hair (#2B1D16) in a loose low chignon at the nape with a few strands falling. Signature: a single strand of 44 pearls restrung on a visibly new bright-white silk thread, pearl stud earrings, glossy red nails, a faint pale mark on the bare left ring finger. Habits: covers her mouth with her hand when she smiles, fingers drift up to the pearls, looks down with her chin raised, perches on the edges of beds and tables.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).
- 말풍선·글자는 이미지에 넣지 말 것 (레터링은 후공정)

  - [dialogue] (무음)

- 실제 브랜드 로고·엠블럼, 실제 화폐 도안, 법원·경찰·교도소 휘장 금지(로고 없는 시계, 퀼팅 체인 백, 도안 없는 소품용 지폐)

- 허용: 몸 라인이 드러나는 의상, 속옷·슬립, 옷이 벗겨지는 과정, 드러난 등·어깨·쇄골·허리·허벅지, 시트로 가린 나신, 역광 실루엣, 손과 입술, 땀과 숨
- 금지: 성기, 유두 노출, 삽입·성행위의 직접 묘사, 체액

Softly handsome long face with an angular jaw, thick straight dark eyebrows, warm long monolid eyes that hold eye contact, faint shadows under the eyes, a high straight nose, thin lips; when he smiles only the LEFT corner of the mouth lifts. Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Default look: white shirt (#F4F4F2), top two buttons open, sleeves rolled to the forearm. No rings. Relaxed, unhurried posture; leans back deep.
- 하린: Yoon Ha-rin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. Habits: pushes up glasses that are already up; slightly hunched student posture that straightens when her hair is tied; bursts out laughing.

Warm beige skin (#E8C29E). Short two-block undercut slicked back, jet black (#1C1F26), with one loose strand falling over the forehead. Signature, always together: a two-tone gold-and-steel wristwatch (no logo) on the LEFT wrist, and right below it a 1.5 cm pale-pink crescent burn scar on the web between the left thumb and index finger. Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.

- 장소 2 와인바 '미란' — 퍼스트 애비뉴 1층 — SET LOCK: Small Korean wine bar called Miran on the ground floor of a new apartment complex shopping street, about 7 m wide and 12 m deep. A dark walnut bar counter 6 m long runs along the right wall with six bar stools, an overhead rack of upside-down wine glasses, and five red glass pendant lamps in a row above it. Behind the counter, a back-bar shelf with a blank chalkboard menu. Along the left wall: a small round marble corner table near the front, a burgundy velvet Chesterfield sofa, and two tall glass-door wine cellars at the back. Dark burgundy hexagon floor tiles, wooden louver blinds on the front glass.
- 화면·연출: 카운터 상판 위 크림색 무지 종이 쇼핑백(검정 끈, 엠보싱 띠, 입구에 투명 테이프 세 겹). 하린의 가는 손가락이 노란 커터칼로 테이프를 긋는 순간을 정지 화면으로 잡는다. 효과음 글자는 넣지 않고 소리는 내레이션 박스로만 전한다(박스 하단).
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- 하린: Yoon Ha-rin, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 25-year-old Korean woman, second-year law school graduate student, clearly a grown adult with mature features. 163 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Slender frame with an unexpectedly full bust that pulls knitwear taut, a very thin waist, narrow hips, long pale slim legs, narrow bony shoulders with pointed collarbone tips. Slim oval face that keeps soft rounded cheeks; languid half-lidded eyes behind thin gold OVAL metal-frame glasses; light natural brows; small nose; small full lips she bites when thinking. Fair skin (#F7DCC8) that flushes easily, ears first. Long straight jet-black hair (#1C1F26) past the chest, usually worn half-up; tied into a high ponytail when she makes a decision. Marks: a black hair tie always on her right wrist, faint glasses marks on the nose bridge, a pen callus on the right middle finger, short bare nails. Habits: pushes up glasses that are already up; slightly hunched student posture that straightens when her hair is tied; bursts out laughing.
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).
- 말풍선·글자는 이미지에 넣지 말 것 (레터링은 후공정)

**레터링(후공정)**
  - [narration] 내레이션: 사각, 하는 소리가 가게 안에 크게 울렸다.

- 모든 얼굴은 창작된 성인 — 실존 인물·유명인과 닮게 만들지 않는다(실화 모티프 작품)
- 실제 브랜드 로고·엠블럼, 실제 화폐 도안, 법원·경찰·교도소 휘장 금지(로고 없는 시계, 퀼팅 체인 백, 도안 없는 소품용 지폐)
- 이미지 안에 말풍선·글자·간판 문구를 넣지 않는다(레터링은 후공정)
- 미성년으로 보이는 표현 금지 — 하린(25)은 성인 체형·성숙한 표정
- 아이(지호 5세, 소이 7세)는 관능 장면과 같은 컷·공간에 두지 않는다

- 장소 2 와인바 '미란' — 퍼스트 애비뉴 1층 — SET LOCK: Small Korean wine bar called Miran on the ground floor of a new apartment complex shopping street, about 7 m wide and 12 m deep. A dark walnut bar counter 6 m long runs along the right wall with six bar stools, an overhead rack of upside-down wine glasses, and five red glass pendant lamps in a row above it. Behind the counter, a back-bar shelf with a blank chalkboard menu. Along the left wall: a small round marble corner table near the front, a burgundy velvet Chesterfield sofa, and two tall glass-door wine cellars at the back. Dark burgundy hexagon floor tiles, wooden louver blinds on the front glass.
- 화면·연출: 띠지 ECU. 노란 지폐 다발을 두른 흰 띠지 끝, 아주 작은 글씨 '소품용'(식자, 작게)만 화면 한가운데에 두고 위아래로 큰 흰 여백을 남긴다. 붉은 펜던트 빛은 띠지 모서리에만 걸린다. 효과음 없음.
- 등장인물(외형 고정값):
- (인물 없음 또는 실루엣)
- 조명·색: 밤 남색 #1A1E3A / 보라 그림자 #3B2F55, 피부 기준 #F3CDB6(인물별 피부는 CHARACTER LOCK 우선), 금빛 보케 #F2C26B. 인물 대표 색(캘린더 색): 유진 회색 #9A9EA3, 미란 버건디 #7A1E2E, 세라 민트 #7FD1BE, 하린 하늘색 #9CC7E8, 혜숙 금색 #C9A45C — 다섯 여자가 한 컷에 나오면 각자의 대표 색이 옷·소품·조명 중 한 곳에 반드시 들어간다. 장면마다 광원은 하나(연출 메모의 조명 줄을 따른다).

  - [dialogue] (무음)

- 실제 브랜드 로고·엠블럼, 실제 화폐 도안, 법원·경찰·교도소 휘장 금지(로고 없는 시계, 퀼팅 체인 백, 도안 없는 소품용 지폐)

- 미란: Cha Mi-ran, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 35-year-old Korean woman, wine bar owner, 165 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. The most pronounced hourglass of the cast: large heavy bust, sharply cinched waist, wide flaring hips, full thighs, a back full of curves. Sharper oval face with soft cheekbones; heavy-lidded, half-closed sultry eyes with smoky eye makeup that curve into crescents only when she laughs out loud; thick bold arched brows; rounded nose; full lips in a long-lasting deep red lipstick. Warm skin (#F2CDB0) that glows under red light. Side-parted voluminous vintage waves, dark wine-brown (#4A2418), falling below the chest. Marks: a small beauty mark below the right corner of her mouth, a thin pale scar on the outer back of her right hand, wine-colored nails (#5A1A26), thin gold hoop earrings. Habits: swirls a wine glass with a loose flexible wrist, throws her head back to laugh, smiles back over her shoulder, sways her hips when she walks in heels.
- 세라: Oh Se-ra, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 28-year-old Korean woman, pilates instructor and former rhythmic gymnast, 168 cm. Toned athletic-curvy body: high, firm, rounded bust, defined abs, small waist, visible hip-bone lines, round firm glutes, strong outer thighs, straight legs, square shoulders with sharp shoulder blades. Two distinct Venus dimples on the lower back just above the waistband, her signature, visible in every back view. Heart-shaped face, bright round eyes, thick short straight brows, small slightly upturned nose with light freckles across the bridge, even full lips with only lip balm. Warm tan bronze skin (#D9A982). Black (#1C1F26) straight hair to mid-back tied in a high bouncy ponytail with loose baby hairs at the temples. Smartwatch on the left wrist, a hair tie, short clear nails, a small surgical scar on the inner left ankle. Habits: spine always upright, walks silently with the ponytail swinging, short laugh through the nose, stretches when annoyed.
- 혜숙: Jeong Hye-suk, fictional adult character, not resembling any real person. A 42-year-old Korean woman, elegant wealthy housewife and residents' association president, 166 cm, a slightly shorter 7.5-head figure. Warm mature hourglass with weight: full heavy bust, softly cinched waist, wide round hips, smooth calves in sheer stockings, a long graceful neck; a slow, low-centered, unhurried body. Soft rounded face with a still-firm jawline and fine smile lines at the eyes; long narrow eyes with elegant winged eyeliner; high thin painted arched brows; straight nose; plump wine-red lips. Well-kept skin (#F0CDB4). Dark chocolate hair (#2B1D16) in a loose low chignon at the nape with a few strands falling. Signature: a single strand of 44 pearls restrung on a visibly new bright-white silk thread, pearl stud earrings, glossy red nails, a faint pale mark on the bare left ring finger. Habits: covers her mouth with her hand when she smiles, fingers drift up to the pearls, looks down with her chin raised, perches on the edges of beds and tables.

Behind the counter, a back-bar shelf with a blank chalkboard menu. Soft glamorous hourglass on a tall frame: full heavy bust, long slender cinched waist, rounded hips, and very long straight legs, her strongest silhouette point. Narrow straight shoulders with deep collarbones; ramrod-straight back, chin slightly tucked. Soft, slightly rounded oval face; languid down-turned eyes with long lashes that never smile even when her lips do; long thin groomed arched brows; slim straight nose; full lips in muted rose-red. Smooth fair skin (#F5D5BE). Wavy bob between chin and collarbone, dark espresso brown (#3A2A22), with soft side-swept bangs. Marks: small pearl stud earrings, two piercing holes in the right earlobe, a tiny mole at the tip of the left collarbone, long pale hands, short almond nude-beige nails, thin wedding band. Habit: polite closed-lip smile with cool unsmiling eyes; sits upright, knees together, legs slanted to one side.
